integrity: A full all-parameter combinatorial proof and two standalone standard-library finite verifiers are included. Finite checks do not replace proof. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two deletions; uniform input-word enumeration. No result for three or more deletions, arbitrary input distributions, or channel capacity. Binary variance known in prior literature; full text of one plausible earlier nonbinary fixed-word paper inaccessible and historical priority remains qualified.
title: Exact size distribution of two-deletion balls over every finite alphabet
